Nejrychlejší celý kilometr je zeleně. Te: The fastest full kilometre is green. Pace is from moving time; stops are not counted.
Tep vůči tempu zůstal po celý běh stejný: Heart rate against pace stayed the same throughout the run.
Trasu vidíte jen vy, fyzioterapeut ani t: Only you can see the route; your physio and coach cannot.
U rovnoměrného běhu od hodiny: kolik ryc: For a steady run of an hour or more: how much speed (adjusted to flat ground) each heartbeat bought in the second half against the first, leaving out the first 10 minutes. The smaller the drift, the better your body holds the pace without the heart rate creeping up. In marathon runners a smaller drift went with faster times (Smyth 2022). The 5 % line is a coaching convention. Heat and fluid loss raise heart rate even without fatigue.
